project.name: WLJ Cycle Tracking Module
project.description: Menstrual cycle tracking module for WLJ Health section. Allows users to log daily cycle data, track period start/end dates, view cycle history on a calendar, receive predictions for next period and fertile window, and see correlations between cycle phase and symptoms/moods over time.

description.objective: Add a gender field to the UserPreferences model with choices: male, female, other, prefer_not_to_say. This field will be used to conditionally enable cycle tracking by default for users who identify as female.

Set field as nullable with blank=True, null=True for existing users.
Add help_text explaining the field is used to personalize health features.
Run makemigrations to create the migration file.
description.output: UserPreferences model has a gender field with four choices, nullable for existing users.

description.objective: Create UserOwnedModel subclass for user cycle tracking preferences with opt-in control.
actions: Create CycleSettings model extending UserOwnedModel.

Add fields: cycle_tracking_enabled (boolean), average_cycle_length (default 28), average_period_length (default 5), notifications_enabled, fertile_window_tracking_enabled, last_period_start_date.
Add is_enabled property for quick checks.
Add help_text for all fields.
description.output: CycleSettings model exists with all preference fields and soft delete support.

tasks.name: Add symptom and mood choice definitions

description.objective: Define standard choices for symptoms and moods in the cycle module.
actions: Define SYMPTOM_CHOICES constant: cramps, headache, fatigue, bloating, breast_tenderness, acne, backache, nausea, food_cravings, insomnia.
Define MOOD_CHOICES constant: happy, sad, irritable, anxious, calm, energetic, tired, emotional.
Define FLOW_LEVEL_CHOICES: none, spotting, light, medium, heavy.
Ensure choices match existing WLJ mood patterns where applicable.
Add display labels with optional emoji indicators.
description.output: Standard choices defined for symptoms, moods, and flow levels.

description.objective: Create model for daily cycle data entry with symptoms, mood, and flow tracking.
actions: Create CycleDailyLog model extending UserOwnedModel.

Add fields: log_date (DateField), flow_level (CharField with choices), symptoms (JSONField for multi-select list), mood (CharField with choices), energy_level (1-5 IntegerField), cervical_mucus (optional), basal_temp (optional DecimalField), notes (TextField).
Add is_period_day property that returns True if flow_level is not 'none'.
Add unique_together constraint on user + log_date.
Add index on user + log_date for efficient queries.
description.output: CycleDailyLog model exists with all tracking fields and unique constraint per user per day.

description.objective: Create model to track complete menstrual cycles with calculated properties.
actions: Create Cycle model extending UserOwnedModel.
Add fields: cycle_number (auto-numbered per user), start_date, end_date (nullable), period_end_date (nullable), notes, is_predicted (boolean for AI predictions).
Add cycle_length property calculating days between start_date and end_date.
Add period_length property calculating days between start_date and period_end_date.
Add index on user + start_date.
Add ordering by -start_date.
description.output: Cycle model exists with auto-numbering and calculated length properties.

description.objective: Create model for storing cycle predictions including fertile window.
actions: Create CyclePrediction model extending UserOwnedModel.

Add fields: predicted_period_start, predicted_period_end, predicted_fertile_window_start, predicted_fertile_window_end, prediction_confidence (DecimalField 0-1), prediction_algorithm_version, generated_at, actual_period_start (nullable, filled when verified).
Add get_active_prediction() class method returning most recent prediction for user.
Add accuracy property comparing predicted vs actual when available.
description.output: CyclePrediction model exists with fields for predictions and accuracy tracking.

tasks.name: Auto-enable cycle tracking for female users

description.objective: Create signal handler to automatically enable cycle tracking when user selects female gender.
actions: Create post_save signal handler on UserPreferences.
Check if gender changed to 'female'.
If female, get_or_create CycleSettings with cycle_tracking_enabled=True.
For male/other/prefer_not_to_say, do NOT auto-create CycleSettings.
If user changes FROM female to other gender, do NOT delete existing CycleSettings (preserve data).
Respect existing CycleSettings if already exists (don't override user's manual choice).
description.output: Signal automatically creates CycleSettings with tracking enabled for female users.

description.objective: Create service class for detecting period start/end from daily logs.
actions: Create CycleDetectionService class in apps/health/services/.
Implement detect_period_start() - triggered when flow_level changes from none to any flow.
Implement detect_period_end() - triggered after 2+ consecutive days of no flow.
Create new Cycle when period starts, close previous cycle.
Update current Cycle with period_end_date when period ends.
Handle spotting intelligently (don't count as new period).
Connect to DailyLog post_save signal.
description.output: Service automatically creates and updates Cycle records based on daily logs.

description.objective: Create service function to calculate current cycle phase based on cycle day.
inputs: CycleSettings for user's average cycle length
actions: Create get_current_phase() function in cycle services.
Define phases: menstrual (days 1-5), follicular (days 6-13), ovulation (days 14-16), luteal (days 17-28).
Adjust phase lengths proportionally based on user's average cycle length.
Return phase name, day within phase, and phase color code.
Return None if user not in an active cycle.
description.output: Function returns current cycle phase adjusted for user's cycle length.

description.objective: Create service class for predicting next period and fertile window.
actions: Create CyclePredictionService class.
Implement predict_next_period() using weighted moving average of last 3-6 cycles.
Weight more recent cycles higher (e.g., most recent = 3x, oldest = 1x).
Implement predict_fertile_window() as days 10-17 of predicted cycle (adjusted for cycle length).
Calculate confidence score based on cycle regularity (standard deviation).
Return None/low confidence if fewer than 3 completed cycles.
Store predictions in CyclePrediction model.
description.output: Service generates period and fertile window predictions with confidence scores.

description.objective: Create service class for calculating cycle statistics and correlations.
actions: Create CycleStatisticsService class.
Implement get_average_cycle_length() over configurable period.
Implement get_average_period_length().
Implement get_symptom_frequency() returning symptom occurrence counts.
Implement get_mood_by_cycle_phase() correlating moods with phases.
Implement get_cycle_regularity_score() (0-100 based on standard deviation).
Implement get_trends() detecting if cycles are getting longer/shorter.
description.output: Service provides comprehensive cycle statistics and pattern analysis.
